records.title: High-risk exposed administrative interface
records.evidence: Offline safe template fixture matched the authorized web-lab URL.
records.remediation: Restrict administrative paths to trusted networks and require strong authentication.

records.title: Directory listing exposes web application paths
records.evidence: Offline lab fixture matched Nmap directory-listing evidence for the authorized Metasploitable3 Apache service.
records.remediation: Disable directory indexing and restrict access to non-public application paths and files.

records.title: phpMyAdmin administrative path is exposed
records.evidence: Offline lab fixture matched the exposed phpMyAdmin path from the authorized Metasploitable3 Nmap artifact.
records.remediation: Remove or restrict phpMyAdmin from untrusted networks and place it behind strong authentication.

records.title: CUPS web interface allows risky PUT method
records.evidence: Offline lab fixture matched the Nmap http-methods evidence showing PUT on the authorized Metasploitable3 CUPS interface.
records.remediation: Disable unnecessary HTTP methods on the CUPS interface and limit administrative access to trusted operators only.
